title: structures for YOU!
description: This mod adds several unique structures, just for YOU!
body:
Adds 3 structures so far
-monoliths! a massive structure that takes up an entire biome (the monolithic wastelands)
![A drop inside a monolith](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/807ac4ac9fcf4528d442535fa74f28ce27694e93_0.webp)
![Inside](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/69a2e19fe9f9339ecbda74e515e62e3bc03b031a_0.webp)![The monolithic wastelands](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/04197aa36e38f765a8a87074305ee1967cf40310_0.webp)
-Catacombs! an underground labyrinth made of mudbricks and bamboo, mainly found in jungles
![Inside the catacombs](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8bcddc7eee5aaeb137ea371376819794678601f5_0.webp)
-what is this again? ![Is that a gubby](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/185d9d8724a8643eba3d843ceba818d5425adec5_0.webp)
